subject: general
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Earth, Forest, Trees
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relation is as shown below :

 
• Some trees are planted in forest. 
 
• Forests are present on earth
 
• Trees are planted on earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/685c88f74daabda90670334ac7182c0d23135f431a66e23ec9f347adca389eba.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
